prompt_text:
You are reviewing a business situation with updated facts.
Use the latest updates when making the final recommendation.
Do not rely on superseded facts.

Scenario ID: icp_buyer_chain_001
Domain: icp_buyer_chain
Topic: champion-shift-from-ops-to-finance

Initial facts:
- Operations managers had been the main champions in the target accounts.
- The team built messaging around workflow speed for operations leaders.
- The pilot proposal was going to be sent to the VP of Operations.

Updated facts:
- Finance directors are now the active economic buyers and final approvers.
- Current deal reviews prioritize budget control and payback period over workflow speed.

Distractors:
- Operations users still like the product demo.
- A prior champion from operations is still willing to introduce the team.

Task: recommend the next business decision.
Return exactly these sections:
## Latest Facts
- List the newest facts you are using.
## Decision
- Give one clear recommendation.
## Rationale
- Explain why the latest facts change the decision.
## Stale Facts To Avoid
- Name any earlier assumptions that should no longer drive the decision.
raw_response:
Latest Facts

• Finance directors are now the active economic buyers and final approvers.
• Current deal reviews prioritize budget control and payback period over workflow speed.

Decision

• Reposition the deal around a finance-first buying case and send the next proposal to finance decision-makers, with operations used as internal supporters rather than primary champions.

Rationale

• The updated facts change both the buyer and the evaluation criteria.
• The main decision power has shifted from operations to finance.
• The core message must therefore shift from workflow speed to budget control, ROI, and payback period.
• Continuing to lead with an operations-first proposal would misalign with the actual approval path and reduce the chance of closing.

Stale Facts To Avoid

• Operations managers had been the main champions in the target accounts.
• The team built messaging around workflow speed for operations leaders.
• The pilot proposal was going to be sent to the VP of Operations.
